Use for author profiles or member metadata not represented by Members APIs.

pitfalls.summary: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-16: safe mode cannot import members at all today. `mockEmailForEntity` (rp-target-wix/lib/wix-writers.js) mints `replatform+<type>_<id>@wix.com`, and POST /members/v1/members rejects that domain with 400 INVALID_EMAIL_DOMAIN — so a safe-mode member import fails wholesale on the first record. The bug hid because Contacts V5 ACCEPTS @wix.com (existing test contacts use it), so only the Members surface trips it. A reserved-TLD address (RFC 2606 `.invalid`) was accepted by other surfaces in the same probe session and is the obvious candidate, but changing the safe-mode address format alters what gets written to a customer's site on every entity, not just members — it needs an explicit decision, not a silent lib patch. Until then: treat safe mode + member import as unsupported and say so in the plan rather than discovering it mid-run.
Passwords are NOT imported — project decision (2026-08-03), not just an API gap. Members keep account/profile/contact linkage; they set a new password via reset. Never propose hash import.

Activation (decided 2026-08-03): passwordless members complete the standard forgot-password flow (confirmed). Delivery = post-import automation (label-added trigger, owner-branded email, label applied in API waves). Never mass-send Send Set Password Email — its link dies in 3h.
No bulk member create; documented >=1s spacing per Create Member call (10k members ~ 3h serial floor). Plan throughput and resume via loginEmail crosswalk.
Original createdDate and lastLoginDate are not writable as native member chronology.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-06: contact.phones[] REJECTS anything not already E.164 ("050-1234567" 400s INVALID_PHONE; "+972501234567" is accepted) -- WooCommerce phones are local-format text and need converting or dropping, never sent as-is. Separately, Contacts dedupes on phone: creating a SECOND member with an unrelated name/email but the SAME phone as a first member returned the FIRST member's contactId -- silently attaching the new person onto the old contact, renaming it in the process -- and this happened even after the first member had been DELETED (deleting a member does not delete its contact; the contact is left orphaned and reusable). rp-target-wix/lib/customer-member.js normalizePhoneE164 converts under an explicit per-country rule or refuses (never guesses); wix-writers.js ensureMember queries Contacts V5 by phone before every create (every phone in the array, not just the first -- an earlier version of this guard checked only phones[0], which a review caught 2026-09-06) and drops the phone(s) (finding member-phone-collision-dropped) rather than risk merging two different source customers. Also cosmetic, not a defect: Members V1 read-back reformats the phone with spaces/dashes for display ("+972 50-999-0001"), while Contacts V5 stores the compact string sent and exposes it again verbatim under phone.e164 -- compare on digits, not the display string.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-06: a freshly created member is NOT immediately findable through Query Members by loginEmail -- one probe saw zero matches at +0ms and +2000ms after Create Member returned, then one match at +5000ms. Create Member's own loginEmail UNIQUENESS check, by contrast, is immediate and case-insensitive (a same-email create in a different case 409s ALREADY_EXISTS right away, with no delay observed). So a caller that reconciles by Query Members before creating (rp-target-wix/lib/wix-writers.js ensureMember) can, within that window, see zero matches for a member that in fact already exists on the target (created moments earlier by an interrupted or concurrent run) and then hit a 409 attempting to create it again. ensureMember reports this as its own outcome (member-already-exists-unreconciled) rather than the generic member-failed, since the record is not lost -- a later run's query will catch up and reconcile it -- but it is not a silent success either. Reconciling through a crosswalk row's GET-by-id (matchedBy: crosswalk) does not depend on this: a fresh site's crosswalk-driven re-run in this project's own live verification reconciled correctly immediately after creation, suggesting GET-by-id does not carry the same lag, though that was not isolated and confirmed the way this consistency gap was.

mappingGuidance: Split author, customer, contact, and login-member roles before selecting targets.

Create Member sends no email and does not fire the signup automations trigger (source-confirmed) — silent import is the default; the only member-facing email is the explicit Send Set Password Email call, which is per-member, interactive-mode, owner-approved only.
setupRequirements: Activation is decided end-to-end: no credential import; post-import the owner creates ONE dashboard automation (label-added trigger → branded email directing members to Log in → Forgot password), then the importer applies the label in API waves for rate control and re-targeting. Enable the automation only after the import window (AUTO-02 pause choreography).
